title: Internal FinanceIQ PIT snapshot envelope v4

fact.title: Structured fact version v4

security_id.description: Durable instrument key, or NOT_APPLICABLE for an entity-level fact. Null is not accepted.

period_type.description: Key coordinate for the declared reporting period, or NOT_APPLICABLE. KER-03 defines Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 (fiscal quarters), H1 (first six months), M9 (first nine months) and FY (fiscal year), each relative to the source-declared fiscal year whose start is valid_from; the period is declared, never inferred from calendar month lengths or a calendar-year assumption. Independent of period_basis. Other uppercase tokens remain structurally valid with no KER-03 semantics.

period_basis.description: Key coordinate for how the declared period is measured, or NOT_APPLICABLE. KER-03 defines CUMULATIVE (accumulated from the declared fiscal-year start valid_from to the end of the named period valid_to, as Turkish interim statements publish 3M/6M/9M/12M amounts) and DISCRETE (the named period alone). period_type and period_basis are independent coordinates: a published fact keeps exactly the pair its source declares (for example FY/DISCRETE or Q2/CUMULATIVE). A discrete quarter computed from the canonical CUMULATIVE pair is a derivative, not a fact version.

currency.description: Uppercase three-letter currency code exactly for monetary units; otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE. Syntax only: membership in a currency registry is not checked.

unit.description: Measurement unit; NOT_APPLICABLE for STRING/BOOLEAN values.

scale.description: Reported multiplier; NOT_APPLICABLE exactly when unit is NOT_APPLICABLE.

consolidation.description: Reporting perimeter; an independent key coordinate, not tied to accounting_basis applicability.

accounting_basis.description: Key coordinate for the accounting/measurement basis, or NOT_APPLICABLE. KER-02 defines TFRS_HISTORICAL (amount as originally published) and IAS29_RESTATED (amount republished in the measuring unit current at a later balance-sheet date); other uppercase tokens stay structurally valid.

measuring_unit_date.description: Recorded IAS 29 measuring-unit date (YYYY-MM-DD) for IAS29_RESTATED; null for every other accounting_basis. Always present so missing and null are never conflated. Measurement metadata only: not a canonical key component or selection coordinate, and never inferred from valid_from, valid_to, known_at or recorded_at.

publication_timezone.description: IANA timezone for DATE_ONLY evidence; required for conservative UTC bounds.

fact.$comment: Canonical fact dimension key, in order: entity_id, security_id, field, period_type, period_basis, currency, unit, scale, consolidation, accounting_basis. Every component is required and non-null; NOT_APPLICABLE is an explicit assertion, never inferred from a missing, null or empty value. measuring_unit_date is required KER-02 metadata outside the key. KER-03 period vocabulary: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, H1, M9, FY and CUMULATIVE, DISCRETE, with no coupling between period_type and period_basis. Patterns end with (?![\s\S]) so they match the whole string in every regex engine (a trailing newline never matches). Instants use the Kernel RFC 3339 grammar shared with Python and PostgreSQL: "T", 0-6 fractional digits, "Z" or an offset up to +-15:59.
fact.description: PIT fact version v4 (KER-03); a published source fact under its published period basis. UNKNOWN public time has null bounds and is never query-eligible. An IAS29_RESTATED comparative is a separate fact from the TFRS_HISTORICAL amount and never supersedes it. Discrete quarters derived from cumulative facts are derivative records, never v4 facts. Cross-field time and interval invariants are enforced by code/storage. Fact v3 remains historical in structured_fact_v3.schema.json and carries no KER-03 period semantics.

description: Contract 4.0.0. At most one published source fact per canonical dimension key; every fact states measuring_unit_date and keeps its source-declared period_type and period_basis. Derived discrete quarters are not exchanged. content_hash is SHA-256 of canonical {contract_version, dimension_key, facts}. Contracts 3.0.0, 2.0.0 and 1.0.0 remain historical in snapshot_envelope_v3.schema.json, snapshot_envelope_v2.schema.json and snapshot_envelope.schema.json.
